objective: Quantify viewer-visible visual density, effective glyph legibility budget and underpopulated narration windows in actual accepted V3-77 native H264/AAC creative videos, without claiming semantic learning efficacy.
frozen_source: V3-77's exact same three host synthetic Storyboards (token_network, score_comparison, symbolic_equivalence). Never relabel as LLM-authored.

metrics.telemetry_frame_coverage: Validate bounded alignment of actual Manim runtime update ticks to H264 frame counts; never imply exact 1:1 mapping
metrics.visual_footprint: Median/P10 and min/max of UNION area of visible scene-owned objects' cached Manim 1.07 bbox in 1280x720; exclude chrome_brand/chrome_top; label as bbox proxy not actual filled pixel area
metrics.content_empty_windows: Longest consecutive ticks with no visible scene-owned object (id contains scene-prefix colon), report approximate seconds from Manim scene time; do not call a deliberate suspense beat a defect automatically
metrics.font_height: Effective per-identity bbox height in native pixels of visible Text SVG group; flag below 24 px as review warning only, excludes chrome; glyph path individual stroke/typographic readability not proven
metrics.legibility: Reuse V3-76 A3 glyph leaf worst-case WCAG 4.5:1; count effective Text reading groups; no OCR claims
metrics.pixel_witness: 9 physical H264 frames per candidate sampled at prereg fractions .10,.20,.30,.40,.50,.60,.70,.80,.90; SHA each decoded pixel; count foreground pixels in scene-owned bbox ROIs with dark background calibration; do not infer exact semantic reading
metrics.salience_gap: Report scene attention distribution and active scene object counts at approximate points; no numerical 3B1B equivalence score

negative_tests: silent overexposure of sparse visual footage

acceptance.technical: Actual fresh 3 narrated Docker Manim H264/AAC, per-movie SHA/codec/decoded sample receipts, telemetry exact provenance and truthful visual density scorecard, strict negative tests + exact-head CI PASS.
acceptance.quality: Only REPORT metrics and reviewer flags; do not hardcode arbitrary occupancy cutoffs or automatically claim visual polish PASS.
acceptance.human: Independent viewer still controls final approval and pedagogical value; do not assert learning gain or 3B1B parity.
